content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

Lemon Squeezy and similar platforms offer rented convenience. They handle hosting, payments, and delivery—until they don’t. For restricted countries, these services are unavailable. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy accounts violate terms of service and risk shutdown. Local payment processors in Nigeria often fail under currency devaluation or regulatory pressure. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, uses open tools you own. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. This architecture bypasses platform dependency. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. No single entity can shut you down. The tradeoff: you manage deployment. But the result is permanent. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured for your products. You get infrastructure sovereignty without the complexity of building it yourself.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Lemon Squeezy exclude restricted countries due to compliance costs, not technical limitations. They rely on payment processors like Stripe, which avoid regions with high regulatory risk. Workarounds using third-party accounts are temporary and risky. Local processors in Nigeria often fail under currency instability or lack international support. Sovereign commerce infrastructure avoids these bottlenecks. It uses decentralized payment networks (crypto) and open hosting tools. NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with no KYC, processing payments on-chain. Cloudflare and GitHub provide global hosting with no geographic restrictions. This architecture is designed for regions where traditional platforms fail. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. You’re not begging for access; you’re building your own base layer. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC email configuration, ensuring your order confirmations don’t land in spam. It’s built for creators who need reliability, not permission.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Lemon Squeezy charges 5% + $0.50 per transaction. Stripe charges 2.9% + $0.30. Neither is available in Nigeria. Local processors often charge higher fees and fail under currency volatility. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transaction costs on BSC, Solana, or TRON networks are under $0.10. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. The real cost of sovereign infrastructure is deployment. You can build it yourself using free tools, but it requires technical skill. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles deployment, configuration, and testing in 48 hours. You pay once, own everything, and avoid recurring platform fees. This model aligns with creators selling high-margin digital products. You keep 99.5% of revenue after on-chain fees. No subscriptions. No revenue share. Just infrastructure you own.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure is not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With Lemon Squeezy, the platform owns your customer data and product delivery. If they shut down or change terms, you lose access. Sovereign infrastructure gives you full ownership. Your store lives on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets. File delivery uses Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments automates payment verification via webhooks. The moment a payment confirms on-chain, the product is delivered. No manual intervention required. The Edge Commerce Stack includes end-to-end testing to ensure this automation works flawlessly. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. COREMERCH has no access after delivery. This architecture is designed for creators who value independence over convenience. You’re not renting a storefront—you’re building a commerce stack.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and need to sell digital products today, sovereign commerce infrastructure is your only permanent solution. Platforms like Lemon Squeezy are unavailable, and workarounds are temporary. Building your own stack from scratch is possible but time-consuming. COREMERCH’s Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys a fully configured commerce stack in 48 hours. It includes hosting, backend logic, payment verification, and file delivery. You get 5 products loaded, email configuration, and 30-day support. If you prefer to build manually, start with GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto processing. But know the tradeoffs: manual deployment requires technical skill and testing. For creators who value ownership over convenience, sovereign infrastructure is the clear choice. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative built for regions where traditional platforms fail.
